question: By which of the following names are the valleys situated between the lesser Himalaya and Shiwaliks known?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Duns**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

 
• The longitudinal valley lying between the lesser Himalayas and the Shiwaliks is known as Duns.
 
• Dehra Dun, Kotli Dun, and Patli Dun are some of the well-known Duns.
